description: This file provides functions for managing user rights and roles within the TestLink project, including rights initialization, permission checks, role retrieval at project and plan levels, and role deletion.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: Class representing a user role, with methods for database operations and display name retrieval.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Class representing a user, with methods for retrieving user roles and IDs.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class for managing test plan data, used to retrieve test plan details.

methods.name: init_global_rights_maps
methods.description: Initializes global maps with user rights and descriptions, localized.

methods.name: has_rights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has a specific right, optionally within a project or plan context.

methods.name: propagateRights
methods.description: Inherits rights from one set to another based on global rights.

methods.name: checkForRights
methods.description: Verifies if a set of rights includes specific role questions, supporting AND/OR logic.

methods.name: get_tproject_effective_role
methods.description: Retrieves effective user roles at the test project level, considering inheritance.

methods.name: get_tplan_effective_role
methods.description: Retrieves effective user roles at the test plan level, considering inheritance and specific roles.

methods.name: getRoleErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a localized error message based on role-related error codes.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role from the database and logs the event.
